summary.title: Glass-styled action sheets replace confirmations
changes: Confirmation dialogs across the app now open as a bottom glass-style action sheet instead of the system popover.
Sheets use a frosted “Liquid Glass” panel appearance with a bold, detached Cancel button.
When Reduce Transparency is enabled the sheets fall back to opaque panels and a stronger dim behind them.
Action labels are localized correctly and dynamic names are shown verbatim where needed.
